name: pi-cap-context-images
description: Bound the number of images kept in a pi session's outgoing provider payload. Prevents the 'infinite compaction' loop caused by base64 screenshots (browser/winshot/image tools) accumulating in context — compaction can summarize text but can only keep or dr
